verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents four theme presets with brand colors and typography in Appearance settings, custom CSS (variables or rules), custom JavaScript and include tags, and custom MDX components, which covers themes, fonts, CSS/JS and your own components. A community user also praised the appearance controls, including a warning when a background color contrasts poorly with text. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of layout and navigation structure control beyond theme presets; custom CSS/JS are gated by plan tier (a community user also wanted a customized landing page on a cheaper plan); and recent independent hands-on corroboration of deep branding customization.
